name: jira-pack
description: Issue-tracker pack: /jira-fix takes a ticket link of any type, verifies tracker access, classifies it as a defect or a change, reproduces the defect or writes a failing acceptance test for the change, routes the work to core executors, comments back with evidence and moves the ticket to the QA column. Opt-in; requires core and an Atlassian MCP provider enabled on the machine.
